## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive. Mixed signals: VXX (1W: +2.88% | 1M: -7.08%) RECOVERY ↑ and HYG (1W: -0.80% | 1M: -1.04%) BELOW TREND ↓ alongside SPY (1W: -1.21% | 1M: -2.19%) BELOW TREND ↓ provide two independent confirmations of a non-directional market.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**
Credit stress creeping: LQD (1W: -1.12% | 1M: -1.70%) BELOW TREND and HYG (1W: -0.80% | 1M: -1.04%) BELOW TREND — HYG/LQD ↓ falling. Commodities/energy strength: BNO (1W: +10.78% | 1M: +24.97%) ABOVE TREND ↑ is a counterweight; VXX (1W: +2.88% | 1M: -7.08%) RECOVERY ↑ flags short-term volatility.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**
Neutral-to-tight: TLT (1W: -1.56% | 1M: -1.63%) BELOW TREND ↓ showing yields moving higher, while UUP (1W: +0.32% | 1M: -0.04%) RECOVERY → mixed dollar impulse.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Energy leading: XLE (1W: +0.73% | 1M: +5.68%) ABOVE TREND. Technology weak: XLK (1W: -1.60% | 1M: -3.40%) BELOW TREND. Style: mixed / no clear leadership (tech and financial/cyclicals not showing coordinated strength).

**5. US vs Global?**
US soft: SPY (1W: -1.21% | 1M: -2.19%) BELOW TREND. EM/China weaker: EEM (1W: -3.94% | 1M: -1.03%) BELOW TREND and FXI (1W: -2.90% | 1M: -0.06%) BELOW TREND — global risk tone tilting down.

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Crypto divergence: IBIT (1W: -1.08% | 1M: +24.69%) CORRECTION shows large 1M gains but short-term pullback. Small cap/speculation cooling: IWM (1W: -2.74% | 1M: -5.14%) BELOW TREND and ARKK (1W: -1.74% | 1M: +2.58%) CORRECTION.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Oil-led reflation: USO (1W: +10.36% | 1M: +25.30%) ABOVE TREND and BNO (1W: +10.78% | 1M: +24.97%) ABOVE TREND. Industrial metals soft: CPER (1W: -4.23% | 1M: -3.99%) BELOW TREND.

**8. Energy Trend?**
Energy strong: XLE (1W: +0.73% | 1M: +5.68%) ABOVE TREND and BNO (1W: +10.78% | 1M: +24.97%) ABOVE TREND ↑; natural gas uneven: UNG (1W: -2.18% | 1M: +3.61%) CORRECTION.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
CONFIRMED: Energy/commodity strength via XLE (1W: +0.73% | 1M: +5.68%) ABOVE TREND and BNO (1W: +10.78% | 1M: +24.97%) ABOVE TREND. DIVERGENCE: equities broadly BELOW TREND — SPY (1W: -1.21% | 1M: -2.19%) BELOW TREND — while IBIT (1W: -1.08% | 1M: +24.69%) CORRECTION highlights asymmetric risk.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor energy/commodity exposure given confirmed strength; reduce exposure to cyclical growth pockets showing weakness (XLK (1W: -1.60% | 1M: -3.40%) BELOW TREND). Bonds: watch — TLT (1W: -1.56% | 1M: -1.63%) BELOW TREND signals tighter financial conditions.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: Energy — XLE (1W: +0.73% | 1M: +5.68%) ABOVE TREND and Oil — BNO (1W: +10.78% | 1M: +24.97%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Tech — XLK (1W: -1.60% | 1M: -3.40%) BELOW TREND and Industrials — XLI (1W: -3.05% | 1M: -8.54%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: Brent/Oil — BNO (1W: +10.78% | 1M: +24.97%) ABOVE TREND; USO (1W: +10.36% | 1M: +25.30%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Copper — CPER (1W: -4.23% | 1M: -3.99%) BELOW TREND; Gold — GLD (1W: -3.42% | 1M: -1.53%) BELOW TREND.

**13. Key Levels?**
VXX 20 (short-term fear pivot), HYG/LQD ~0.80–0.95 (credit health trigger), XLK/XLF ratio ~2.0 (growth vs value pivot).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive with mixed ratio signals (VXX RECOVERY ↑ and HYG/LQD ↓). Energy/commodities showing relative strength while equities and credit show divergence — monitor IBIT CORRECTION and TLT weakness as the key risks.
